title: the WSG boating proficiency
audit_comment: The boating-proficiency slice pins the nonproficient penalties - the movement-rate reductions (kayak, small canoe and coracle at one-half, small rowboat, large canoe, large rowboat and small barge at two-thirds, large barge at three-quarters, applied before the wind and current alterations), the +25% capsize penalty where the base chance exceeds zero, capped at 100%; the proficient-crew benefits - the -20% capsize reduction per proficient character after the first, the -20% mast/sail damage reduction with the rigging-brace assumption, the all-proficient waiver of the movement penalties, and the two-character sail crews for the large rowboat, the small barge and the large barge (rules/wsgboat.h, prefix wbp); census 381 -> 382.

banner.title: The WSG THE BOATING PROFICIENCY, R457: this section deals primarily with the effects of not having a character with boating proficiency aboard. In a vessel containing no proficient characters, or one in which at least one non-proficient character is doing some of the work of rowing or sailing, the penalties apply: the movement rates of a kayak, a small canoe and a coracle are reduced to one-half of normal; a small rowboat, a large canoe, a large rowboat and a small barge to two-thirds of normal; and a large barge to three-quarters of normal - the reduction applied before any other alterations (wind speed and current speed) are taken into account. The chance of capsizing is increased by 25% in any situation where the chance is normally greater than 0%, to a maximum of 100%. With more than one proficient character aboard: the chance of capsizing is reduced by 20% for each proficient character after the first one; the chance of damage to the mast or sails is reduced by 20%, assuming the proficient characters have some means of making the rigging secure or bracing the mast so that it will better withstand the stress. If ALL of the characters helping to row or sail a vessel have proficiency in boating, the movement penalties do not apply and the movement rates are as given on the table at the beginning of this section. Two characters are required to sail a large rowboat, a small barge or a large barge; all other vessels can be sailed by one character.

consts.name: wbpVesselCount
consts.comment: The same eight vessels as Tables 25 and 26: kayak, small canoe, small rowboat, coracle, large canoe, large rowboat, small barge and large barge.

consts.name: wbpCapsizeNonprofAdd
consts.comment: With no proficient character aboard, the chance of capsizing is increased by 25% in any situation where the chance is normally greater than 0%.

consts.name: wbpCapsizeCeiling
consts.comment: The increased capsize chance can never exceed 100%.

consts.name: wbpCapsizeExtraProfCut
consts.comment: The chance of capsizing is reduced by 20% for each proficient character after the first one.

consts.name: wbpMastDamageProfCut
consts.comment: The chance of damage to the mast or sails is reduced by 20% when more than one proficient character is aboard, assuming they can secure the rigging or brace the mast.

consts.name: wbpTwoHandedSailCrew
consts.comment: Two characters are required to sail a large rowboat, a small barge or a large barge; all other vessels can be sailed by one.

bools.name: wbpPenaltyIfNoneProficient
bools.comment: The penalties apply in a vessel containing no proficient characters.

bools.name: wbpPenaltyIfAnyNonprofWorking
bools.comment: The penalties also apply when at least one non-proficient character is doing some of the work of rowing or sailing.

bools.name: wbpReductionBeforeWindCurrent
bools.comment: The movement-rate reduction is applied before any other alterations - wind speed and current speed - are taken into account.

bools.name: wbpCapsizeAddOnlyIfBasePositive
bools.comment: The +25% capsize penalty applies only in situations where the chance is normally greater than 0%.

bools.name: wbpCapsizeCappedAtCeiling
bools.comment: The capsize chance after the penalty is capped at the 100% ceiling.

bools.name: wbpExtraProfsReduceCapsize
bools.comment: Each proficient character after the first reduces the chance of capsizing.

bools.name: wbpMastCutNeedsRiggingBrace
bools.comment: The mast/sail damage reduction assumes the proficient characters can make the rigging secure or brace the mast against the stress.

bools.name: wbpAllProficientWaivesMovePenalty
bools.comment: If all of the characters helping to row or sail the vessel have proficiency, the movement penalties do not apply and the rates are as given on the movement table.

bools.name: wbpSailCrewIsTwoHanded
bools.comment: The two-handed sail-crew minimum holds for the large rowboat, the small barge and the large barge; every other vessel sails with one.
